penditure fund , for the fiscal year ending June 30,
1927 , for the purpose of contributing to the compen-
sation of visiting nurses under the provisions of sec-
tion 4 of chapter 51 of the Acts of 1918 , the sum of
$7,500.00 . Said sum is to paid out only in the man-
ner and for the purposes set out in said chapter 51
of the Acts of 1918 .
§ 49. West Kentucky Industrial College , Padu-
cah , Kentucky . There is hereby appropriated out
of the general expenditure fund for the support and
maintenance of the West Kentucky Industrial Col-
lege , for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1927 , as per
act of the General Assembly of 1922 , the sum of
$15,000.00 .
In addition to the above appropriation there is
also appropriated out of the general expenditure
fund the following sums for the following purposes :
(a) For maintenance and operation , $5,000.00 .
(b ) For the purchase of a farm , thirty-eight
thousand ($38,000.00 ) dollars .
( c) For the payment of cost of construction of
an auditorium , $ 6,800.00 .
( d ) For repairs of buildings and equipment ,
$2,000.00 .
$ 50. Kentucky Crippled Children Commission .
There is hereby appropriated out of the general ex-
penditure fund for the use and benefit of the Ken-
tucky Crippled Children Commission , for the fiscal
year ending June 30 , 1927 , for the purpose of pay-
ing salaries , printing , postage , traveling and inci-
dental expenses , for the maintenance and operation
of said commission , for the purpose of the payment
of the necessary traveling expenses of children com-
mitted to the said commission , and for the payment
of board , suitable clothing, care , treatment and other
necessities to enable the commission to carry out the
provisions of the Act of the General Assembly of
ACTS OF THE GENERAL Assembly 57
1924 creating said commission . the sum of $ 100 , -
000.00 .
51. Kentucky State Park Commission . There
are hereby appropriated out of the general expendi-
ture fund for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1927 ,
for the use and benefit of the Kentucky State Park
Commission , the following sums for the following
purposes :
(a) For the payment of traveling and hotel ex-
penses , printing , stationery , reports , postage and
other incidental expenses of the commission , the
sum of $ 1,000.00 .
(b ) For the maintenance and improvement of
the Cumberland State Park in Bell County , $8,000.00 .
(c ) For the maintenance and improvement of
the Kentucky Natural Bridge State Park in Powell
and Wolf counties , $ 6,400.00 .
(d ) For the maintenance and improvement of
the Pioneer Memorial State Park in Mercer County ,
$4,800.00 .
(e) For the maintenance and improvement of
the Blue and Gray State Park in Todd County ,
$4,800.00 .
Section 51 - a . State Purchasing Commission .
There is hereby appropriated out of the general
expenditure fund , for the fiscal year ending June 30 ,
1927 , for the purpose of paying all of the expenses
of the State Purchasing Commission , including the
salary of its chairman , traveling expenses of its
members , and its office furniture furnishings and
equipment , and expenses of clerical and manual help
and assistance , not to exceed the sum of twenty thou-
sand dollars ( $20,000.00 ) .
$ 52. Budget Appropriation Commission . For
the use and benefit of the Budget Appropriation
Commission , for the fiscal year ending June 30 ,
1927 , for the purpose of paying the clerical, steno-
graphic hire and other expenses authorized to be
incurred by said commission , under the law , there
is hereby appropriated out of the general expendi-
ture fund , the sum of $500.00 .
§ 53. Miscellaneous . In order to meet and pro-
vide for the payment for the fiscal year ending June
30 , 1927 , of the sums necessary to pay the costs of
suits , attorneys ' fees , conveyance of lunatics to the
various asylums for the insane , commissions on fines
and forfeitures , compensation for county tax com-
mission , as now provided by law, costs of criminal
prosecutions , amounts due the various clerks of the
Commonwealth for their services and authorized to
be paid out of the State Treasury , cost and distri-
bution of public books , express charges not other-
wise provided for in this act ; the cost of the care
of graves in the Frankfort cemetery , as allowed by
law , the yearly allowances made to idiots by the var-
ious circuit courts of the Commonwealth , interest
on outstanding warrants or on warrants that may
hereafter be issued , the per diem compensation for
the jury commissioners of the various counties of
the Commonwealth , the per centum of Jefferson
County fees refunded to the various officers of Jef-
ferson County, as now authorized by law , the sums
allowed for the Law Library of the Commonwealth ,
to cover all moneys that may be required to be re-
funded as now provided by law , or as may hereafter
be provided by law , the cost of public books , includ-
cluding record books , compensation of the various
county boards of supervisors , any and all rewards
authorized by law , and any and all exonerations al-
lowed to the sheriff by law , any and all amounts
authorized by law to be paid to the trustee of the
jury fund of the various counties of the Common-
wealth , and any other general expenditures now al-
lowed by law and payable out of the general ex-
penditure fund of the Commonwealth , the Auditor
is authorized and directed to draw his warrant for
the amount due , and the Treasurer is authorized to
pay the same , in the manner now authorized by law
for the payment of such claims . For the purpose
of paying all costs of operation of the Legislative
Department of the State government , and of the
Judicial Department of the State government , the
common school system and salaries of Common-
wealth's Attorneys , for the fiscal year ending June
30 , 1927 , and not specifically provided for in this
act , the Auditor of Public Accounts is authorized
and directed to draw his warrant and the Treasurer
to pay the same in the manner now provided by law
for the payment of such claims .
§ 54. Each section of this act appropriating
money is designed to be a separate and distinct ap-
propriation , and , in event any appropriation made
is held to be unauthorized by law , it shall in no wise
affect the other appropriations provided for in this
act .
55. No officer or employe of the state , or any
of the departments , boards , commissions or agencies
of the State government provided for in this act ,
shall be allowed any expenses incurred in trips out-
side of Kentucky except on official business , and then
only after a request to make such trips has been filed
in writing with the Commissioners of the Sinking
Fund and authority to make same has been approved
by the said Commissioners of the Sinking Fund .
Attached to the foregoing act is the following veto message
signed by the Governor of Kentucky , March 24 , 1926 : "House
Bill No. 586 having been delivered to me on March 17 , 1926 , I
disapprove subsection (f ) of section forty-four appropriating
twelve thousand ( $ 12,000.00 ) dollars . All other provisions and
appropriations contained in House Bill No. 586 are hereby ap-
proved . This March 24 , 1926 .
W. J. FIELDS , Governor .

$ 46. Kentucky School for the Deaf . There are hereby appropriated out of the general expenditure fund for the benefit of the Kentucky School for the Deaf , for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , the following sums for the following purposes : (a) For the payment of salaries , $ 65,600.00 . Six hundred dollars ( $ 600.00 ) of said amount shall be paid and added to the salary of the attending physi- cian of said Kentucky School for the Deaf . (b) For office supplies , maintenance , provisions , repairs , furniture , furnishings and equipment and insurance, $46,000.00 . ( c ) For traveling expenses , and transportation for indigent pupils to and from school , $ 500.00 . (d) For construction and equipment of hospital building , $20.000.00 . CHAPTER 12 .
AN ACT appropriating money for the operation and maintenance
of the various departments , boards , commissions , institutions
and agencies of the state government , except for the legisla-
tive and judicial departments , and except for the common
schools , for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 ; designating
the funds and sources from which said appropriations are to
be paid , and prescribing the manner in which same are to be
paid .
Be it enacted by the General Assembly of the Com-
monwealth of Kentucky :
$ 1. Executive Department . There are hereby
appropriated out of the general expenditure fund
for the Executive Department of the State Govern-
ment , for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , the
following sums for the following purposes :
( a ) For salary of the Governor , private secre-
tary and stenographic help and other employes ,
$15,470.00 .
(b ) For contingent and maintenance fund ,
$6,000.00 .
(c) For printing , stamps , office supplies and ope-
ration of the department , $1,900.00 .
§ 2. Lieutenant Governor . There is hereby ap-
propriated out of the general expenditure fund for
the use and benefit of the Lieutenant Governor , for
the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , for the purpose
of paying clerical hire and other expenses , the sum
of $ 2,500.00 .
§ 3. Secretary of State . There is hereby appro-
priated out of the general expenditure fund for the
use and benefit of the Department of Secretary of
State , for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , for
the purpose of paying all salaries , clerical help , por-
ter , printing , stamps , office supplies , and all other
expenses incident to the operation of said depart-
ment , the sum of $20,300.00 .
§ 4. Attorney General . There are hereby appro-
priated out of the general expenditure fund for the
use of the Attorney General's Department of the
Commonwealth of Kentucky , for the fiscal year end-
ing June 30 , 1928 , the following sums for the follow-
ing purposes :
(a ) For salaries of the Attorney General , As-
sistant Attorneys General and law clerks , $ 15,800.00 .
(b) For stenographic help , the salaries to be de-
termined by the Attorney General, $8,400.00 .
( c) For necessary traveling expenses of the de-
partment , when engaged in the state's business ,
printing , stamps and office supplies , $2,500.00 .
5. Auditor of Public Accounts . There are
hereby appropriated out of the general expenditure
fund for the use of the Department of the Auditor
of Public Accounts of the Commonwealth of Ken-
tucky, for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , as
hereinafter set out , the following sums for the fol-
lowing purposes :
( a ) For salaries and clerical hire , $ 35,000.00 .
(b) For printing , stamps , office supplies and nec-
essary traveling expenses , $4,000.00 .
6. State Treasurer . There is hereby appro-
priated out of the general expenditure fund for the
use and benefit of the State Treasurer's Depart-
ment , for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , for
the purpose of paying salaries , clerical help , print-
ing, stamps , supplies and all other expenses inci-
dent to the maintenance and operation of said de-
partment , the sum of $ 15,000.00 .
§ 7. Superintendent of Public Instruction . There
is hereby appropriated out of the public school fund
of the State for the use and benefit of the Depart-
ment of the Superintendent of Public Instruction ,
for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , for the pur-
pose of paying all salaries , as now fixed by law , or
may hereafter be fixed by law , for all necessary
clerical, stenographic , traveling and other expenses ,
and professional assistance in said department , the
sum of $55,000.00 .
§ 8. Department of Agriculture , Labor and Sta-
tistics . There are hereby appropriated out of the
general expenditure fund for the use of the Depart-
ment of Agriculture , Labor and Statistics , for the
fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , the following
amounts for the following purposes :
( a ) For the purpose of paying all the salaries
and clerical hire for said department , $ 12,500.00 .
(b) For the purpose of paying per diem , travel-
ing and other expenses now allowed by law to the
State Board of Agriculture , $4,500.00 .
(c ) For the purpose of paying all the expenses
of the immigration branch (free employment ) of
said department as now allowed by law , or as may
hereafter be allowed by law , $2,000.00 .
( d ) For the purpose of paying for the station-
ery, printing , office supplies , equipment , telephone
and telegraph bills , express , freight and hauling
charges and postage of said department , and travel-
ing expenses of the commissioner , $ 6,300.00 .
(e) For the purpose of paying all the expenses
included in the field work of said department now
permited and allowed by law , or as may hereafter
be authorized by law; for defraying the expenses of
said department and collecting statistics , as is now,
or may hereafter be , allowed by law ; for paying spe-
cial premiums which said department is now or may
hereafter be authorized by law to pay ; and for cre-
ating an emergency and cooperative fund for the
use of said department , as now or may hereafter be
authorized by law , $ 15,700.00 .
(f) For the purpose of paying the salaries ,
printing , postage and general expenses connected
with the Department of Forestry , and for coopera-
tion with the federal forestry laws , $ 15,000.00 .
(g ) For the purposes of paying the salaries ,
printing , postage and general expenses connected
with the State Labor Department , the sum of fifteen
thousand ( $15,000.00 ) dollars .
§ 9. Clerk Court of Appeals . There is hereby
appropriated out of the general expenditure fund
for the benefit of the office of the Clerk of the Court
of Appeals , for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 ,
for the purpose of paying all salaries , printing , of-
fice supplies , janitor service and other expenses in-
cident to the operation of said office , the sum of
$20,000.00 .
$ 10 . Railroad Commission . There is hereby ap-
propriated out of the general expenditure fund for
the use and benefit of the Railroad Commission , for
the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , for the purpose
of paying all salaries , traveling expenses , printing ,
stamps , office supplies and all other expenses inci-
dent to the operation and maintenance of said de-
partment , the sum of $ 18,000.00 .
§ 11. State Librarian . There is hereby appro-
priated out of the general expenditure fund for the
use and benefit of the State Librarian , for the fiscal
year ending June 30 , 1928 , for the purpose of pay-
ing all salaries , printing , books , stamps , office sup-
plies and other costs incident to the operation and
maintenance of said department as now provided by
law , or as may hereafter be provided by law ,
sum of $8,300.00 .

§ 12. Department of Banking . ( a ) There is
hereby set aside and appropriated for the use and
benefit of the Department of Banking , for the fiscal
year ending June 30 , 1928 , for the purpose of pay-
ing all salaries , printing , stamps , supplies and other
expenses of the operation and maintenance of said
department , all of the fees realized from examina-
tions of the sundry banks and building and loan as-
sociations as now provided by law , or as may here-
after be provided by law .
(b) For the purpose of paying salaries , clerical
help , traveling expenses , printing , stamps and office
supplies in the operation of the Blue Sky Depart-
ment , there is hereby appropriated and ordered to
be paid out of the fees collected under the provi-
sions of the Blue Sky Department Law, for the fiscal
year ending June 30 , 1928 , the sum of $ 10,000.00 .
§ 13. State Board of Election Commissioners .
There is hereby appropriated out of the general ex-
penditure fund for the benefit of the State Board of
Election Commissioners , for the fiscal year ending
June 30 , 1928 , for the purpose of paying salaries or
clerical hire , printing , stamps and all necessary ex-
penses and supplies , the sum of $610.00 .
§ 14. Confederate Pension Department . There
are hereby appropriated out of the general expendi-
ture fund for the benefit of the Confederate Pension
Department , for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 ,
the following sums for the following purposes :
( a ) For salaries and clerical hire , $ 4,600.00 .
(b ) For the payment of pensions heretofore al-
lowed , or that may hereafter be allowed , $ 315,000.00 .
( c) For printing , stamps , office supplies and
other expenses of operation , $ 1,900.00 .
§ 15. Kentucky Confederate Home . There are
hereby appropriated out of the general expenditure
fund for the benefit of the Kentucky Confederate
Home , for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , the
following sums for the following purposes :
( a ) For the salaries of officers and employes ,
$14,550.00 .
(b ) For all expenses of operation and mainte-
nance , and marking graves on home grounds , $ 35 ,-
450.00 .
16. Fire Prevention and Rating Department .
For the purpose of administering the fire prevention
and rating department , as now provided by law , and
for the purpose of paying the salaries , including
clerical help , and all other expenses incident to the
maintenance and operation of said department now
allowed by law, or as may be hereafter allowed by
law , for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , there
is hereby set aside and appropriated to the use of
said department the amount allowed for the pur-
pose by section 4 of chapter 16 of the Acts of 1920 ,
same to be paid from the sources therein designated .
§ 17. Game and Fish Commission . For the fis-
cal year ending June 30 , 1928 , there is hereby set
aside and appropriated for the benefit of the Game
and Fish Commission , to be expended by it for the
purposes now allowed by law , or that may hereafter
be allowed by law , all the fees and collections of all
kinds and character now collected by law , or that
may hereafter be imposed by law , for the benefit of
said department .
§ 18. State Tax Commission . For the use and
benefit of the State Tax Commission , for the fiscal
year ending June 30 , 1928 , for the payment of all
salaries , including clerical help , traveling expenses ,
printing , stamps , office supplies and all other ex-
penses incident to the administration of the laws
relating to revenue and taxation and licensing of
motor vehicles , dealers and chauffeurs , there is here-
Acts- 3
by appropriated out of the state revenues the funds
now, or that may hereafter be authorized by law,
and not exceeding fifty ( 50 ) cents for each motor
vehicle registered out of the amount realized from
licenses on motor vehicles , and out of the general
expenditure fund the sum of $ 80,000.00 .
$ 19. Superintendent of Public Printing. There
is hereby appropriated out of the general expendi-
ture fund , for the use and benefit of the Superinten-
dent of Public Printing, for the fiscal year ending
June 30 , 1928 , for the purpose of paying all salaries ,
clerical help , traveling expenses , printing , stamps
and office supplies , $2,000.00 .
§ 20. State Inspector and Examiner . There is
hereby appropriated out of the general expenditure
fund for the use and benefit of the Department of
the State Inspector and Examiner , for the fiscal
year ending June 30 , 1928 , for the purpose of paying
all salaries , traveling expenses , printing , stamps ,
office supplies and all other expenses incident to the
maintenance and operation of said department , the
sum of $25,000.00 .
21. Custodian of Public Buildings . There are
hereby appropriated out of the general expenditure
fund for the benefit of the Custodian of Public
Buildings , for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 ,
the following sums for the following purposes :
(a ) For all salaries of custodian and other em-
ployes , $35,000.00 .
(b ) For repairs , supplies , permanent improve-
ments of public buildings , and all other maintenance
and operating expenses , including printing , stamps
and office supplies , $42,000.00 .
$ 22. Kentucky State Historical Society . There
is hereby appropriated out of the general expendi-
ture fund for the use and benefit of the Kentucky
State Historical Society , for the fiscal year ending
June 30 , 1928 , for the purpose of paying salaries of
all officers and employes , including janitor , and all
other expenses incident to the maintenance , opera-
tion and conduct of said department , the sum of
$6,720.00 .
§ 23. Insurance Department. There is hereby
set aside and appropriated to the use of the Insur-
ance Department , for the fiscal year ending June
30 , 1928 , for the payment of salaries and all other
expenses of maintenance and operation of said de-
partment, as now provided by law , or as may here-
after be provided by law , all the fees and collections
to which said department is now entitled by law , or
may hereafter be entitled by law .
§ 24. Kentucky Library Commission . There is
hereby appropriated out of the general expenditure
fund for the use and benefit of the Kentucky Li-
brary Commission , for the fiscal year ending June
30 , 1928 , to be expended by it for the purposes now
allowed by law , or that may hereafter be allowed by
law , the sum of $ 9,000.00 .
25. State Board of Examiners of Trained
Nurses . For the use and benefit of the State Board
of Examiners of Tned Nurses , for the fiscal
year ending June 30 , 1928 , there is hereby set aside
and appropriated for the purpose of paying all cost
of maintenance and operation of said board , all
the fees and other collections collected for the use
and benefit of said board , as now provided by law ,
or as may hereafter be provided by law.
§ 26. State Live Stock Sanitary Board . There is
hereby appropriated out of the general expenditure
fund for the use and benefit of the State Live Stock
Sanitary Board , for the fiscal year ending June 30,
1928 , for the purpose of paying all salaries , travel-
ing expenses , printing , stamps , supplies and all
other expenses incident to the maintenance and
operation of said department , as now provided by
law, or as may hereafter be provided by law , the
sum of $35,000.00 .
§ 27. Workmen's Compensation Board . For the
use and benefit of the Workmen's Compensation
Board , for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , for
the purpose of paying all salaries , traveling expen-
ses , printing , stamps , supplies and other expenses
of the operation and maintenance of said board ,
as now provided by law , or as may hereafter be
provided by law , there is hereby set aside and ap-
propriated all the funds now collected by law , or
that may hereafter be collected by law , for the bene-
fit
ofsaid Workmen's Compensation Board
.

$ 30 . Department of Mines and Mining . There
is hereby appropriated out of the general expendi-
ture fund for the Department of Mines and Mining ,
for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , for the pur-
pose of the payment of all salaries , clerical hire ,
traveling expenses allowed by law , printing , stamps ,
supplies and all other cost of maintenance and oper-
ation of said department , the sum of $30,000.00 .
$ 31. State Printing Commission . There is
hereby appropriated to the State Printing Commis-
sion out of the general expenditure fund , for the
purpose of paying for the necessary paper for use
in State printing , for the fiscal year ending June 30,
1928 , in the manner now provided by law , the sum of
$65,000.00 .
$ 32 . Morehead State Normal School and Teach-
ers College . For the purpose of paying for the main-
tenance and operation of the Morehead State Nor-
mal School and Teachers College , for the fiscal year
ending June 30 , 1928 , for instruction , extension
work , traveling expenses , fuel , light , printing , post-
age, insurance , express and drayage , telegraph and
telephone , janitor service , library, and other gen-
eral and miscellaneous supplies and operating ex-
penses, there is set aside and appropriated out of
the State revenue the funds now authorized by law ,
or that may hereafter be authorized by law , in the
distribution of the State revenue , for the mainten-
ance and operation of said institution .
( a) There is appropriated and set aside out of
the general expenditure fund for the fiscal year end-
ing June 30 , 1928 , for the use and benefit of said in-
stitution for the payment of one -half of the cost of
the construction , furnishing and equipment of two
dormitories and improvement of buildings and
grounds , in the sum of $ 160,000.00 .
§ 33. Murray State Normal School and Teach-
ers College . For the purpose of paying for the
maintenance and operation of the Murray State
Normal School and Teachers College , for the fiscal
year ending June 30 , 1928 , for instruction , extension
work , traveling expenses , fuel , light , printing , post-
age, insurance , express and drayage , telegraph and
telephone , janitor service , library and other general
and miscellaneous supplies and operating expenses ,
there is set aside and appropriated out of the State
revenues the funds now authorized by law , or that
may hereafter be authorized by law in the distribu-
tion of the State revenues for the maintenance and
operation of said institution .
( a ) There is appropriated out of the general ex-
penditure fund for the fiscal year ending June 30 ,
1928 , for the use and benefit of said institution for
the payment of one-half the cost of the construction ,
heating and equipment of a general class room and
training school and the extension and installation of
water, light and sewerage systems , in the sum of
$100,000.00 .
(b) There is also appropriated out of the gen-
eral expenditure fund for the fiscal year ending June
30 , 1928 , for the use and benefit of said institution
for the payment of the cost of furniture , furnishings ,
fixtures and equipment of buildings and improve-
ments of grounds, in the sum of $25,000.00 .
$ 34 . Board of Charities and Corrections . There
are hereby appropriated out of the general expendi-
ture fund for the use of the State Board of Charities
and Corrections in charge of the charitable , correc-
tional and penal institutions of the Commonwealth
of Kentucky , for the necessary expenditures for the
fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , the following
amounts for the following pruposes :
(a ) For the purpose of paying the salaries , cler-
ical hire , traveling expenses , printing , stamps and
necessary supplies for said State Board of Charities
and Corrections , and cost of operation, mainte-
nance , improvements , repairs and all operating ex-
penses for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , for
the State Reformatory at Frankfort , State Peniten-
tiary at Eddyville , Western State Hospital for the
Insane at Hopkinsville , Central State Hospital for
the Insane at Lakeland , Eastern State Hospital for
the Insane at Lexington , Feeble -Minded Institute at
Frankfort and the Houses of Reform , $ 1,185,000.00 .
(b ) For the same purposes in addition to the
said sum of $ 1,185,000.00 , there is hereby appropri-
ated to the said State Board of Charities and Correc-
tions all receipts of every character and kind real-
ized by the said board in the operation of each and
that all receipts of every character and kind real-
ized by said board in the operation of each and
every institution under the control and supervision
of said State Board of Charities and Corrections ,
including the receipts realized by the said board
from the operation of convict road camps , provided
that all receipts of every character and kind real-
ized by said board in the operation of each and
every institution under its control and supervision ,
shall be paid into the State Treasury and warrants
drawn upon said receipts through the Auditor of
Public Accounts in paying out said sums ; provided ,
that no part of this appropriation shall be used for
the construction of permanent buildings .
(c ) For the Houses of Reform at Greendale , for
the purchase of land , purchase and installation of
boilers , for the construction and equipment of a re-
frigerator plant , and the remodeling of two build-
ings, $40,000.00 .
(d) For the Feeble -Minded Institute at Frank-
fort, for erecting buildings , stand pipe and water ex-
tensions , and repairs , $37,500.00 .
(e ) For the construction and equipment of a
nurses ' home at the Eastern State Hospital for the
Insane at Lexington , $20,000.00 .
(f ) For the construction and equipment of a
building for the criminal insane at the Central State
Hospital for the Insane at Lakeland , $25,000.00 .
(g ) For the purchase and installation of boilers
at the State Penitentiary at Eddyville , $ 7,500.00 .
Provided , that the special appropriations for per-
manent improvements made herein to the above
State Board of Charities and Corrections for said
fiscal year shall not be paid , and if paid the amount
thereof so paid shall be remitted and credited to the
general fund if a bond issue for the benefit of said
State Board of Charities and Corrections is submit-
ted to and adopted by the voters of the State at an
election held for said purpose ; and said funds so
paid shall be refunded out of the proceeds of the first
bonds issued and sold under and by authority of
said so approved bond issue .
§ 35. Department of Public roads . For the pur-
pose of paying all the costs of operation and main-
tenance of the Department of State Roads and
Highways , and for carrying on its activities for the
fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , there is hereby set
aside and appropriated to the Department of State
Roads and Highways all the funds now realized out
of the State revenues now authorized by law , or that
may hereafter be authorized by law , in the distribu-
tion of the State revenues for the construction , main-
tenance and repair of roads or any additional or
other revenues that may be imposed by law for the
exclusive benefit of public roads and all funds real-
ized from the automobile license and gasoline taxes
now collected by law , or that may hereafter be
imposed or collected by law for the benefit of said
department in its activities . Out of said funds so
realized and collected for said fiscal year there is
appropriated and authorized to be paid for the pur-
pose of paying the salaries of the State Highway
Commission , the State Highway Engineer , the ex-
ecutive Secretary and all persons employed in the
central office of said department , all salaries of per-
sons employed in the district engineers ' offices and
testing engineer's office , all costs of inspection and
supervision , the traveling expenses of all persons
authorized under the law to draw same , all printing ,
office supplies and cost of location surveys and plans ,
together with all other expenses incurred in the
maintenance and operation of said department ex-
clusive of money actually spent in the construction
and maintenance of roads , the sum of $500,000.00 .
•
Said sums shall be so distributed and expended
for said purposes herein enumerated as in the judg-
ment of the State Highway Commission may be best
for the efficient operation of the department and
the carrying on of its activities , but no more than
$200,000.00 of said $ 500,000.00 shall be expended for
the cost of making preliminary and final location
surveys and plans . All of the fund appropriated by
this section , exclusive of said $ 500,000.00 , shall be
used exclusively by said department for the con-
struction , reconstruction , maintenance and repair
of public roads . And in addition to the $500,000.00
herein specifically set apart , the Highway Commis-
sion may in its discretion expend out of its revenues
not to exceed $ 50,000.00 for topographic mapping
under the direction and supervision of the Director
of the Geological Survey .
$ 36 . University of Kentucky . There are hereby
appropriated and set aside out of the funds and
from the sources hereinafter designated , for the use
and benefit of the University of Kentucky , for the
fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , the following sums
from the following funds and sources and for the
following purposes :
( a ) For the purpose of paying salaries and all
other expenses of maintenance and operation of the
Division of Colleges of the University of Kentucky
in the manner now authorized by law , or as may
hereafter be authorized by law , there is set aside
and appropriated out of the State revenue now au-
thorized by law , or that may hereafter be authorized
by law in the distribution of the State revenue , for
the purpose of the maintenance and operation of
said institutions .
In addition to the sums set aside and appropri-
ated out of the State revenue under Sub - section (a)
above , there is appropriated out of the general ex-
penditure fund the following sums for the follow-
ing purposes :
(b ) For the purpose of paying for the cost and
maintenance and operation of the Experiment Sta-
tion of the University of Kentucky for said fiscal
year , as now authorized by law, or as may hereafter
be authorized by law, the sum of $50,000,00 .
(c) For the purpose of paying all the cost of the
maintenance and operation of the Extension Divis-
ion of the University of Kentucky for said fiscal
year in the manner now authorized by law , or as
may hereafter be authorized by law , the sum of
$142,241.30 .
( d ) For agricultural instruction , $30,000.00 .
(e) For the purpose of paying the Experiment
Station of the University of Kentucky for making
all analyses for the State Board of Health under the
provisions of chapter 65 of the Acts of 1918 , and for
making all analyses requested by any other depart-
ment of the State government , to be paid in equal
monthly installments , the sum of $ 18,000.00 .
(f) For the payment of one-half the cost of a
girls ' dormitory $ 75,0000.00 .
(g ) For salaries , expenses and cost incident to.
the maintenance of a summer school , $ 10,000.00
(h) For the Princeton Experiment Station , an-
nual appropriations as provided in the Act of 1924 ,
$20,000.00 . For building three cottages , stock barn ,
fencing and other permanent improvements , $ 11 ,-
000.00 .
(i ) For the Quicksand Experiment Station , an-
nual appropriation as provided in the Act of 1924 ,
$ 25,000.00 .
(j ) For payment on the purchase of 103 acres of
land as addition to the Experiment Station now
under option , $ 10,375.00 .
Provided , that the special appropriations for per-
manent improvements made herein to the above
University of Kentucky for said fiscal year shall
not be paid , and if paid the amount thereof so paid
shall be remitted and credited to the general fund
if a bond issue for the benefit of the said State
University is submitted to and adopted by the
voters of the State at an election held for said pur-
pose ; and said funds so paid shall be refunded out
of the proceeds of the first bonds issued and sold
under and by authority of said so approved bond
issue .
§ 37. State Board of Health . There are hereby
appropriated out of the general expenditure fund
for the use of the State Board of Health , for the
fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , the following
amounts to be used for the following purposes :
(a) For the purpose of paying salaries , clerical
help , traveling expenses , printing , stamps , supplies
and all other operating expenses $ 60,000.00 .
(b ) For the prevention of venereal diseases
$15,000.00
(c) For the prevention and treatment of tra-
choma , $ 15,000.00 .
(d ) For the prevention and treatment of tuber-
culosis , $ 10,000.00 .
(e ) For the protection of the health of mothers
and children in accordance with Section 3 , Chapter
120 of the Acts of 1920 , to be spent in co -operation
with the Federal Government , and in connection
with funds received from the Federal Government ,
$21,298.84 .
(f) For Department of Bacteriology and Epi-
demiology the sum of two thousand four hundred
dollars ($2,400.00 ) for the increase of salaries of
employees of such Department .
(g) For Social Hygiene and Sex Education , Five
Thousand Dollars ( $ 5,000.00 ) to be used by the Ven-
ereal Disease Bureau ,
(h) To provide free beds for tubercular indi-
gent patients at Hazelwood Sanatorium ten thou-
sand dollars ( $ 10,000.00 ) .
§ 38. Eastern Kentucky State Normal School
and Teachers College . There is hereby appropriated
out of the State revenue now authorized by law ,
or that may hereafter be authorized by law, in the
distribution of the State revenue , for the mainte-
nance and operation of the Eastern Kentucky State
Normal School and Teachers College , for the fiscal
year ending June 30 , 1928 , for the purpose of paying
all salaries , traveling expenses , printing , stamps ,
supplies and all other expenses of maintenance and
operation of said institution for said fiscal year :
( a) There is appropriated out of the general ex-
penditure fund for the fiscal year ending June 30 ,
1928 , for the use and benefit of said instituition for
the payment of one-half the cost of the completion
of the construction of a girls ' dormitory and equip-
ment thereof , in the sum of $100,000.00 .
(b ) There is also appropriated out of the general
expenditure fund for the fiscal year ending June
30 , 1928 , for the use and benefit of said institution
for the payment of one-half the cost of the con-
struction of a joint class room building and the
completion of the administration building and the
equipment thereof , in the sum of $ 60,000.00 .
$ 39. Western Kentucky State Normal School
and Teachers College . There is hereby appropriated
out of the State revenue now authorized by law ,
or that may hereafter be authorized by law , in the
distribution of the state revenue , for the mainte-
nance and operation of the Western Kentucky State
Normal School and Teachers College , for the fiscal
year ending June 30 , 1928 , for the purpose of paying
all salaries , traveling expenses , printing , stamps ,
supplies and all other expenses of maintenance and
operation of said institution for said fiscal year :
( a) There is appropriated out of the general ex-
penditure fund for the fiscal year ending June 30 ,
1928 , for the use and benefit of said institution for
the payment of one-half the cost of the construc-
tion , furnishing and equipment of a general class
room and library building , in the sum of $100,000.00 .
(b ) There is also appropriated out of the general
expenditure fund for the fiscal year ending June
30 , 1928 , for the use and benefit of said institution
for the payment of one-half the cost of the remodel-
ing of the present recitation building and the con-
struction of additional class rooms and the furnish-
ing and equipment thereof, in the sum of $20,000.00 .
(c) There is also appropriated out of the gen-
eral expenditure fund for the fiscal year ending
June 30 , 1928 , for the use and benefit of said insti-
tution for the payment of one -half the cost of the
construction , equipment and installation of heating
and power plants and for the extension and install-
ation of light , water and sewerage systems and im-
provements of grounds , in the sum of $40,000.00 .
$ 40 . State Board of Agriculture . There are
hereby appropriated out of the general expenditure
fund , for the use of the State Board of Agriculture ,
for the Kentucky State Fair , for the fiscal year end-
ing June 30 , 1928 , the following sums for the fol-
lowing purposes :
(a) For salaries , traveling expenses , mainte-
nance and operation , $ 10,000.00 .
(b ) For premiums for the Kentucky State Fair ,
$15,000.00 .
(c) For the purpose of purchasing and laying
water pipe , mains , hydrants , sewerage , drainage ,
and for repairs on grand stand , barns , roofs , roads ,
pavilion , insurance , and for the construction and
equipment of a poultry building , $25,000.00 .
( d ) In addition to the above appropriations
there are hereby appropriated to the State Board of
Agriculture , for the use and benefit of the Kentucky
State Fair, including additional premiums , all sums
realized by the State Board of Agriculture from the
sales of concessions , admissions , advertising , entry
fees , stalls , rents , exhibitors ' tickets , rent of build-
ings and grounds , and from pavilion , grand stand ,
and midway show receipts .
§ 41. Kentucky Geological Survey . There are
hereby appropriated out of the general expenditure
fund for the Kentucky Geological Survey , for the
fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , the following sums
for the following purposes :
(a) For the purpose of making geological , chem-
ical , technical , soil and other investigations author-
ized by the provisions of chapter 34 of the Acts of
1920 , for the purpose of paying all salaries , includ-
ing the salary of the Director and State Geologist ,
field expenses , clerical expenses , clerical assistance ,
laboratory , field equipment ,field equipment , supplies , freight
charges , and all necessary miscellaneous items of
permanent improvement to the property and effects
of the Kentucky Geological Survey , and for the pur-
pose of paying for all office expenses , printing and
traveling expenses , $40,000.00 .
§ 42. Kentucky Children's Home Society for
White Children . There are hereby appropriated
out of the general expenditure fund for the use of
the Kentucky Children's Home Society for White
Children , for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 ,
the following sums for the following purposes :
(a) For the purpose of paying all salaries and
every other expense incident to the operation and
maintenance of said department as now, or that may
hereafter be , provided by law , $ 80,000.00 .
$ 43 . Kentucky Children's Home Society for Col-
ored Children . There is hereby appropriated out
of the general expenditure fund for the use and bene-
fit of the Kentucky Children's Home Society for Col-
ored Children , for the fiscal year ending June 30 ,
1928 , for the purpose now authorized by law , or for
such other purpose as may be hereafter provided
by law, the sum of $20,000.00 .
$ 44. Kentucky Normal and Industrial Institute
for Colored Persons . There is hereby appropriated
out of the general expenditure fund for the use and
benefit of the Kentucky Normal and Industrial In-
stitute for Colored Persons , for the fiscal year end-
ing June 30 , 1928 , the following sums for the follow-
ing purposes :
(a) For the payment of salaries and all other ex-
penses incident to the maintenance and operation of
said department as now provided by law , or as may
hereafter be provided by law, the sum of $ 48,000.00 .
(b) For the purpose of extinguishing the deficit.
heretofore incurred in the operation of said institu-
tion , $13,000.00 .
(c) For general maintenance and repair , $11 ,-
000.00 .
(d ) For the purpose of purchasing farm machin-
ery, building roads , fencing, and repairing of farm
buildings , $7,000.00 .
45. Kentucky Institution for the Education of
the Blind. There are hereby appropriated out of
the general expenditure fund for the use and benefit
of the Kentucky School for the Blind , for the fiscal
year ending June 30 , 1928 , the following sums for
the following purposes :
(a ) For the payment of salaries and all other
expenses incident to the maintenance and operation
of the White Department of the Kentucky School
for the Blind , $ 60,000.00 .
( b ) For the payment of salaries and all other
expenses incident to the maintenance and operation
of the Colored Department of the Kentucky School
for the Blind , the sum of $9,500.00 .
( c ) For the education and vocational training
of the adult blind of Kentucky , to be expended in the
manner and for the purpose now provided by law ,
or as may hereafter be provided by law , $ 20,000.00 .
$ 46. Kentucky School for the Deaf . There are
hereby appropriated out of the general expenditure
fund for the benefit of the Kentucky School for the
Deaf , for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , the
following sums for the following purposes :
(a) For the payment of salaries , $ 65,600.00 . Six
hundred dollars ( $ 600.00 ) of said amount shall be
paid and added to the salary of the attending physi-
cian of said Kentucky School for the Deaf .
(b) For office supplies , maintenance , provisions ,
repairs , furniture , furnishings and equipment and
insurance, $46,000.00 .
( c ) For traveling expenses , and transportation
for indigent pupils to and from school , $ 500.00 .
(d) For construction and equipment of hospital
building , $20.000.00 .
(e ) For fencing and walks , $3,000.00 .
(f) For salaries and all expenses incident to the
operation and maintenance of the department for
colored children , $9,000.00 .
$ 47 . Vocational Educational Board . There are
hereby appropriated for the use and benefit of the
Vocational Educational Board of Kentucky , for the
fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , the following sums
out of the following named funds and for the follow-
ing named purposes :
( a ) For the purpose of carrying on teacher
training instruction in the state of Kentucky under
the provisions of chapter 7 of the Acts of 1918 , there
is hereby appropriated out of the general expendi-
ture fund , $ 24,987.00 .
(b) For the purpose of paying all the cost of in-
spection and supervision of courses in teacher train-
ing under the provisions of chapter 7 of the Acts of
1918 , there is appropriated out of the general ex-
penditure fund , $ 2,500.00 .
( c) For the purpose of the promotion of voca-
tional rehabilitation of persons disabled in industry
or otherwise , and their return to civil employment ,
there is hereby appropriated out of the excess of
the funds collected from the tax on premiums paid
to insurance carriers writing compensation insur-
ance in Kentucky not required for the maintenance
of the Workmen's Compensation Board , not to ex-
ceed the sum of $ 22,955.00 .
§ 48. Visiting County Nurses . There is hereby
appropriated and set aside out of the general ex-
penditure fund , for the fiscal year ending June 30 ,
1928 , for the purpose of contributing to the compen-
sation of visiting nurses under the provisions of sec-
tion 4 of chapter 51 of the Acts of 1918 , the sum of
$7,500.00 . Said sum is to be paid out only in the
manner and for the purposes set out in said chapter
51 of the Acts of 1918 .
§ 49. West Kentucky Industrial College , Padu-
cah , Kentucky . There is hereby appropriated out
of the general expenditure fund for the support and
maintenance of the West Kentucky Industrial Col-
lege , for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 , as per
act of the General Assembly of 1922 , the sum of
$15,000.000 .
(a ) In addition to the above appropriation there
is also appropriated out of the general expenditure
fund , for the use of said institutions for mainten-
ance and operation , the sum of $ 5,000.00 .
$ 50. Kentucky Crippled Children Commission .
There is hereby appropriated out of the general ex-
penditure fund for the use and benefit of the Ken-
tucky Crippled Children Commission , for the fiscal
year ending June 30 , 1928 , for the purpose of paying
salaries , printing , postage , traveling and incidental
expenses , for the maintenance and operation of said
commission , for the purpose of the payment of the
necessary traveling expenses of children committed
to the said commission , and for the payment of
board , suitable clothing , care , treatment and other
necessities to enable the commission to carry out the
provisions of the Act of the General Assembly of
1924 creating said commission , the sum of $100,000.-
00 .
51. Kentucky State Park Commission . There
are hereby appropriated out of the general expendi-
ture fund for the fiscal year ending June 30 , 1928 ,
for the use and benefit of the Kentucky State Park
Commission , the following sums for the following
purposes :
(a ) For the payment of traveling and hotel ex-
penses , printing , stationery, reports , postage and
other incidental expenses of the commission , the
sum of $1,000.00 .
(b ) For the maintenance and improvement of
the Cumberland State Park in Bell County , $ 8,000.00 .
(c ) For the maintenance and improvement of
the Kentucky Natural Bridge State Park in Powell
and Wolfe counties , $6,400.00 .
(d ) For the maintenance and improvement of
the Pioneer Memorial State Park in Mercer County ,
$4,800.00 .
(e ) For the maintenance and improvement of
the Blue and Gray State Park in Todd County,
$4,800.00 .
Section 51a . State Purchasing Commission .
There is hereby appropriated out of the general ex .
penditure fund , for the fiscal year ending June 30 ,
1928 , for the purpose of paying all of the expenses
of the State Purchasing Commission , including the
salary of its chairman , traveling expenses of its
members , and its office furniture , furnishings and
equipment , and expenses of clerical and manual help
and assistance , not to exceed the sum of Twenty
Thousand Dollars ( $ 20,000.00 ) .
$ 52 . Miscellaneous . In order to meet and pro-
vide for the payment for the fiscal year ending June
30 , 1928 , of the sums necessary to pay the costs of
suits , attorneys ' fees , conveyance of lunatics to the
various asylums for the insane , commissions on
fines and forfeitures , compensation for county tax
commissioners , as now provided by law, costs of
criminal prosecutions , amounts due the various
clerks of the Commonwealth for their services and
authorized to be paid out of the State Treasury ,
cost and distribution of public books , express
charges not otherwise provided for in this act ; the
cost of the care of graves in the Frankfort cemetery ,
as allowed by law , the yearly allowances made to
idiots by the various circuit courts of the Common-
wealth , interest on outstanding warrants or on war-
rants that may hereafter be issued , the per diem
compensation for the jury commissioners of the var-
ious counties of the Commonwealth , the per centum.
of Jefferson County fees refunded to the various of-
ficers of Jefferson County, as now authorized by
law , the sums allowed for the Law Library of the
Commonwealth , to cover all moneys that may be re-
quired to be refunded as now provided by law , or
as may hereafter be provided by law , the cost of pub-
lic books , including record books , compensation of
the various county boards of supervisors , any and
all rewards authorized by law , and any and all ex-
onerations allowed to the sheriff by law , any and all
amounts authorized by law to be paid to the trustee
of the jury fund of the various counties of the Com-
monwealth , and any other general expenditures now
allowed by law and payable out of the general ex-
per.diture fund of the Commonwealth , the Auditor
is authorized and directed to draw his warrant for
the amount due , and the Treasurer is authorized to
pay the same, in the manner now authorized by law
for the payment of such claims . For the purpose
of paying all costs of operation of the Legislative
Department of the State government , and of the
Judicial Department of the State government , the
common school system and salaries of Common-
wealth's Attorneys , for the fiscal year ending June
30 , 1928 , and not specifically provided for in this
act, the Auditor of Public Accounts is authorized
and directed to draw his warrant and the Treasurer
to pay the same in the manner now provided by law
for the payment of such claims .
$ 53 . Each section of this act appropriating
money is designed to be a separate and distinct ap-
propriation , and , in event any appropriation made
is held to be unauthorized by law , it shall in no wise
affect the other appropriations provided for in this
act .
54. No officer or employe of the State , or any
of the departments , boards , commissions or agencies
of the state government provided for in this act ,
shall be allowed any expenses incurred in trips out-
side of Kentucky except on official business , and
then only after a request to make such trips has been
filed in writing with the Commissioners of the Sink-
ing Fund and authority to make same has been ap-
proved by the said Commissioners of the Sinking
Fund .
Approved March 24 , 1923 .

laws.full_text:
CHAPTER 82
AN ACT to repeal chapter 45 , Acts of 1920 , being an act to au-
thorize consolidated school districts and county boards of edu-
cation to issue bonds ; and sections 4100 and 4101 , and 4420a -2 ,
and 4420a -3, which relate to the collection of graded school
taxes from railroad and bridge companies ; and section 4484
in chapter 8 of Acts of 1922 , referring to colored graded school
districts ; and sections 4431 and 4432 of Kentucky Statutes ,
which refer respectively to transfer of pupils and to estab
lishment of city, town or village school districts ; and sections
4426a -3 , 4426a -5, 4426a -6 and 4426a -9 of Kentucky Statutes ,
which refer to boundaries , consolidation and taxation of school
subdistricts and the election of trustees and teachers in con-
solidated subdistricts ; and sections 4458 , 4459 , 4460 , 4461 , 4462
and 4463b of Kentucky Statutes , all of which relate to sub-
district taxation ; and section 5 of chapter 138 of Acts of 1918 ,
which relates to consolidation of school districts ; and to pro-
vide more adequately for the establishment of consolidated
school subdistricts , the change of boundaries of districts and
subdistricts , the levy , collection and expenditure of school
taxes , and the issue and sale of bonds for school purposes in
common school districts and subdistricts .
Be it enacted by the General Assembly of the Com-
monwealth of Kentucky :
That chapter 45 of the Acts of the General As-
sembly of 1920 , which relates to the issue of
bonds by consolidated school districts , be and the
same is hereby repealed ; also sections 4100 , 4101 ,
4420a -2 , and 4420a -3, which relate to the collection
of graded school taxes from railroad and bridge
companies ; also section 4484 in chapter 8 of Acts of
the General Assembly of 1922 , which relates to col-
ored graded schools ; also sections 4431 and 4432 of
Kentucky Statutes , which refer respectively to
changes of subdistrict boundaries and the establish-
ment of special districts ; also sections 4426a -3,
4426a -5, 4426a - 6 , 4426a -9 , of Kentucky Statutes ,
which refer to boundaries , consolidation and taxa-
tion of school subdistricts and the election of trus-
tees and teachers in consolidated school subdis-
tricts ; also sections 4458 , 4459 , 4460 , 4461 , 4462 , and
4463b of Kentucky Statutes , all of which relate to
subdistrict taxation ; also section 5 of chapter 138 of
Acts of the General Assembly of 1918 , which relates
to consolidation of school districts , be and the same
are hereby repealed , and in lieu thereof are now
enacted the following :
§ 1. Every county in this Commonwealth shall
constitute one county school district ; provided that
in any county in which there is an independent
graded school district , or city school district contain-
ing a city of the first , second, third or fourth class ,
the county school district shall be composed of the
remainder of the county outside of such independ-
ent district or districts . The county board of educa-
tion of any county shall have full power , except as
otherwise provided in this act , to change the boun-
daries of school subdistricts of the county school
system and , when necessary , to establish new sub-
districts or to unite subdistricts or parts of subdis-
tricts ; provided that the boundary of any subdistrict
having bonded indebtedness cannot be extended ex-
cept upon written petition of two -thirds of the legal
voters in the territory proposed to be added ; and
provided, further , that no subdistrict shall be estab-
lished or maintained with fewer than fifty children
of school age except in case of emergency , nor in any
case with fewer than twenty -five such children . But
the county board of education may at any time au-
thorize and provide for the transfer of any child,
children or grades in any subdistrict to the public
school of another subdistrict if it is nearer or other-
wise desirable .
§ 2. The county board of education shall have
power to lay off a proposed subdistrict or consoli-
dated subdistrict boundary within the county school
district and submit to the voters within that bound-
ary the proposition of authorizing the levy annually
of a tax for local or consolidated school purposes ,
which shall include transportation of all pupils who
do not live within reasonable walking distance of
school , at a rate not exceeding seventy -five cents on
each one hundred dollars of taxable property within
the district as valued in assessment for State
and county purposes next preceding the levy of
the tax . On written petition of a majority of
the board of education of any city or graded
common school district in the county , or of forty
per cent of the legal voters of such district ,
the county board of education may include such
district in the proposed boundary ; or on written
petition of a majority of the subdistrict trustees of
the county may include all the subdistricts thereof
in such proposed boundary. Such proposition for
taxation may be submitted to the voters of the pro-
posed boundary by the county board of education
at an election called for that purpose , or at the regu-
lar election of school trustees ; provided , that not less
than fifteen days ' notice be given of said election by
written or printed posters signed by the chairman
and secretary of the county board , stating the pur-
pose of the election , the boundary affected , and the
date , place or places , and hours of said election ,
posted at not les than two public places in each dis-
trict or subdistrict concerned and by one insertion
of the notice in a newspaper , if there be one pub-
lished in the county . The county board of education
shall appoint at least three citizens of the proposed
boundary to serve as election officers in said election
and to certify the returns of same to the county
board of education . In case a majority of the votes
cast are in favor of the tax proposition , the pro-
posed boundary shall thereafter be a district or sub-
district of the county school system , and the tax so
authorized shall be levied annually by the fiscal
court of the county in accordance with requisition by
the county board of education and be included by the
county clerk in the regular tax bills rendered for
county purposes , and shall be collected by the sheriff
and settled for with the county board of education
as in the case of county school taxes and at the same
rate of commission for collection ; but if a majority
of the votes cast are against the proposition the dis-
trict status and boundary will be unchanged by the
election . All such taxes shall be for the use and ben-
efit of the school or schools attended by the children
of such subdistricts .
§ 3. The county board of education in any
county may at any time submit to the voters of any
proposed subdistrict or group of subdistricts the
question whether or not said board shall issue and
sell bonds of such proposed subdistrict or group
of subdistricts in any amount not exceeding the limit
provided by section 158 of the Constitution of this
Commonwealth , for the purpose of establishing ,
maintaining , and operating a public school or
schools for such subdistrict or subdistricts , and the
annual levy of a school tax sufficient to provide a
sinking fund for the payment of interest on the
bonds annually and the liquidation of the bonds at
their maturity . The election for this purpose shall
be called and conducted in accordance with the pro-
visions of section 2 in this act , and the tax , if ap-
proved by two -thirds of the votes cast , shall be col-
lected and settled for as therein provided . Election
for this purpose may at the discretion of the county
board of education be called at the same time and
place as that provided for in section two of this act ,
and conducted by the same election officers .
$ 4. When a graded school is situated in a city
or town of the fifth or sixth class , the boundary of
the graded school district shall include the entire
corporate limits of such city or town , and any exten-
sion of same , and such adjacent rural territory as
may be included in the graded school district at the
time this act goes into effect . Any boundary within
a graded school district that is more convenient to
the public school of an adjacent graded school dis-
trict or of an adjacent county school district may be
transferred to the district whose school is more con-
venient by concurrent action of the boards of educa-
tion of the two districts concerned .
Approved March 22 , 1926 .

laws.full_text:
CHAPTER 90
AN ACT to repeal and re -enact chapter 33 of the Acts of the
General Assembly of 1902 ( page 71 ) , which is entitled "An
Act to change the name of the State Normal School for Col-
ored Persons , and regulate the conduct of same ," same being
section 4527 -a Kentucky Statutes , 1915 edition , and giving the
Kentucky State Industrial College for Colored Persons the
right to issue certificates to graduates in the various courses
taught in the Kentucky State Industrial College for Colored
Persons .
Be it enacted by the General Assembly of the Com-
monwealth of Kentucky :
That chapter 33 of the Acts of 1902 , being entitled
" An act to change the name of the State Normal
School for Colored Persons , and to regulate the con-
duct of same , " be and the same is now repealed , and
re -enacted , and as re -enacted shall read as follows ,
to -wit :
That the name of the State Normal School for
Colored Persons is hereby changed to the following ,
to -wit : " Kentucky State Industrial College for Col-
ored Persons , " and the board of trustees shall be
known as the Board of Trustees of Kentucky State
Industrial College for Colored Persons .
That the president of the college , who shall be
styled the " President of the College , " and shall be
the chief administrative officer of the college under
control of the board of trustees . The president shall
be elected during the month of June , 1926 , and shall
be elected by the board for a term of four years .
That the Kentucky State Industrial College for Col-
ored Persons shall have the right to certificate any
graduate of its institution to teach any branch of
school work in any colored school in the State of
Kentucky , and any person holding such certificate
shall not be required to pass any further examina-
tion before any school authorities of the State .
Whereas , the school terms always close in June
of each year, and arrangements for the conduct of
the college , including the employment of teachers
for the succeeding school year , can be more advan-
tageously done and arranged before the end of the
school term , it is considered that an emergency
exists for this law , and it shall be and become a law
upon its pasage and approval by the Governor of
the Commonwealth .
Approved March 25 , 1926 .

laws.full_text:
CHAPTER 91
AN ACT creating a board of trustees for the West Kentucky In-
dustrial College , repealing chapter 18 of the Acts of the Gen-
eral Assembly of 1918 , and chapter 100 of the Acts of the
General Assembly of 1922 , and sections 489 , 490 , and 491 of
Senate Bill No. 28 , in the present session of the General As-
sembly .
Be it enacted by the General Assembly of the Com-
monwealth of Kentucky :
That chapter 18 of the Acts of the General Assem-
bly of 1918 and chapter 100 of the Acts of the Gen-
eral Assembly of 1922 and sections 489 , 490 and 491
of Senate Bill No. 28 , in the present session of the
General Assembly be repealed , and that the follow-
ing be enacted in lieu thereof :
§ 1. Board of Trustees -Appointment and
Term of Members . The West Kentucky Industrial
College shall hereafter be under the control and
supervision of a board of trustees composed of the
Superintendent of Public Instruction , who shall be
ex-officio chairman of the board , and four intelligent
and discreet citizens of this Commonwealth ap-
pointed by the Governor , which board is hereby con-
stituted a body corporate , with power to sue and be
sued , plead and be impleaded , purchase and sell and
hold real and personal property in the name of the
Commonwealth of Kentucky for use and benefit of
said college , and to condemn real estate in the man-
ner provided by law for condemnation of land for
railroad purposes , said board to be designated as
"The Board of Trustees of West Kentucky Indus-
trial College ." The terms of office of the members
appointed by the Governor shall end on the first
day of July next following regular sessions of the
General Assembly, the terms of two members end-
ing every two years ; but the two members whose
terms end at the same time shall not belong to the
same political party . Appointment of members to
this board shall be made in accordance herewith ,
provided that the terms of appointed members in
office when this act goes into effect shall continue for
the full terms for which they were appointed . The
Governor is authorized to remove members for
cause , and to fill irregular vacancies by appointment
for the remainder of the unexpired term .
§ 2. Organization - Meetings - Expense of
Members . In the month of July next following the
regular appointment of members , the Board of
Trustees of West Kentucky Industrial College shall
have its biennial organization meeting , when it shall
elect a secretary to serve for a term of two years
and until his successor is elected , and may elect one
of its members vice chairman to preside at any
meeting in the absence of the chairman . Regular
meetings shall be held quarterly at such times as
the board may determine , and on written request of
two members the chairman may call a special meet-
ing for the transaction of only such business as may
be specified in calling the meeting . All meetings
shall be held at the college except as the board may
otherwise provide . Members shall receive no salary
for services as members , appointees or employes of
the board , or be interested financially in any con-
tract or business transaction with it , but they shall
receive return from its treasury for all legitimate
and necessary expenses actually incurred in attend-
ing its meetings .
3. General Powers . The board of trustees
shall have general control and management of the
college and shall have power to appoint a president,
teachers and other employes for the college and to
prescribe their duties and fix their salaries and
terms , but the term of no employe or appointee of
the board shall be for more than one year after expi-
ration of the term of any members incumbent when
such appointments are made . It shall have power
to adopt and enforce rules and regulations for the
guidance of its employes and students . It may re-
quire of officers and teachers such reports as it may
deem necessary ; may dismiss any of its employes
for immorality , insubordination or neglect of duty
after opportunity for defense against charges pre-
ferred ; and may invest the faculty with power to
dismiss or suspend pupils for misconduct or ineffi-
ciency , subject to right of appeal to the board of
trustees . It shall not incur obligations or indebted-
ness in any school year in excess of its assured in-
come for such year.
§ 4. Quorum . A majority of the members of
the board shall constitute a quorum for the transac-
tion of business ; but no appropriation of money or
contract for the expenditure of money shall be made ,
nor shall any teacher or other employe be employed
or dismissed , unless a majority of the members of
the board vote for same .
§ 5. Purpose- Courses - Diplomas . It shall
be the purpose of the West Kentucky Industrial
College to train teachers for colored schools and to
give industrial collegiate training to young men and
women of the negro race . The board of trustees
shall prescribe the courses of instruction to be given,
and shall issue diplomas of graduation to students
completing such courses of junior college rank . Stu-
dents completing such courses in the teacher train-
ing department shall be given diplomas , and shall
also receive teachers ' certificates according to law
without further examination . The courses offered
in this institution shall be open to colored young
men and women resident in this Commonwealth on
such conditions as the board of trustees may pre-
scribe and without the payment of the tuition fees ,
and shall be open to nonresidents of this Common-
wealth on payment of such tuition fees as the board
may prescribe .
§ 6. Secretary. The secretary of the board
shall preserve its records and papers ; shall keep a
journal of its proceedings , in which at the request
of any member of the board the yeas and nays on
any vote shall be entered ; shall perform such other
secretarial duties as the board may direct ; and shall
receive compensation prescribed by the board.
7. Treasurer . The board of trustees shall
appoint a treasurer , fix his compensation , determine
the amount of his bond to the Commonwealth at not
less than ten thousand dollars for the security of
funds in his custody and faithful performance of
duty, approve same , and keep it on file with the sec-
retary of the board . He shall keep in safe custody
all funds , securities , deeds and insurance policies be-
longing to the board of trustees , holding them sub-
ject to its order , and shall pay out the funds only on
its order legally made . He shall make to the board
at the close of each quarter an itemized and classi-
fied report of its receipts , disbursements and bal-
ances for the quarter , and at the close of the school
year a similar report for the year closed , such re-
port to be made in duplicate including one copy for
the Superintendent of Public Instruction .
Approved March 27 , 1926 .

§ 3. The object of the State trade and training school for negroes shall be to train negro boys and girls in the elementary branches , agriculture , me- chanic arts , practical mining , carpentry , black- smithing, shoemaking , modern housekeeping , plas- tering , brick masonry , dressmaking , designing and domestic science .

§ 4. There is hereby created a board of re- gents for said State trade and training school , to be known as " The Board of Regents for the State Trade and Training School for Negroes . " The said board shall have perpetual succession , with power to contract and be contracted with , to sue and be sued , to plead and be impleaded , to receive by any legal mode of conveyance property of any descrip- tion , and to have and hold and enjoy the same ; also to make and use a corporate seal , with power to alter the same ; to adopt by-laws , rules and regula- tions for the government of their members , official agents and employes ; provided , such by -laws do not conflict with the Constitution of the United States or with the Constitution of the State of Kentucky .
